items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: In fact Dave Winstein was working there. ... He was a town saxophone player. ... Winstein was in that band with you? No.

ctx.x: Give it to the Jazz Museum.

We had a lot of things, we had a lot of things down there that we found up there. Yeah. And we wanted to have them sort of remember a rebellion room. Dave, I don't want anything like that. In fact, Winstein, I even, I was president of the Home Association, I still am. Not that it means anything. But, I told Dave, I said, we ought to get these, we ought to have a bronze plaque who built this, our building now and this and the officers.
